title: NaN 传染与 nan-aware 聚合、掩码替代写法
expected_output:
a = [ 1. nan  3. nan  5.]
sum()     = nan （NaN 会传染整个结果）
nansum()  = 9.0
mean()    = nan
nanmean() = 3.0
isnan 个数 = 2
--- 掩码法等价写法 ---
a[~isnan].mean() = 3.0
--- 二维按轴 ---
b =
[[ 1. nan]
 [ 3.  4.]]
nanmean(axis=0) = [2. 4.]
nanmean(axis=1) = [1.  3.5]
--- 全为 NaN 时会告警并返回 nan ---
结果 = nan | 触发告警数 = 1
code:
import warnings
import numpy as np
a = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3.0, np.nan, 5.0])
print("a =", a)
print("sum()     =", a.sum(), "（NaN 会传染整个结果）")
print("nansum()  =", np.nansum(a))
print("mean()    =", a.mean())
print("nanmean() =", np.nanmean(a))
print("isnan 个数 =", int(np.isnan(a).sum()))
print("--- 掩码法等价写法 ---")
print("a[~isnan].mean() =", float(a[~np.isnan(a)].mean()))
print("--- 二维按轴 ---")
b = np.array([[1.0, np.nan], [3.0, 4.0]])
print("b =")
print(b)
print("nanmean(axis=0) =", np.nanmean(b, axis=0))
print("nanmean(axis=1) =", np.nanmean(b, axis=1))
print("--- 全为 NaN 时会告警并返回 nan ---")
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    v = np.nanmean(np.array([np.nan, np.nan]))
    print("结果 =", v, "| 触发告警数 =", len(caught))
